rationale: New domain: /docs/dispatch.md plus the AGENTS.MD route ('plan a dispatch wave and pointed to a .md file') define a wave-routing/assignment planning task whose deliverable is a single JSON assignment object optimized for expected net profit. No existing BP covers it; it is information/planning, not a commerce mutation.

dependencies.why: Wave/package/lane model, routing constraints, the expected-net-profit objective, and the exact output JSON schema.
/uploads as the root for the request-named wave and TSV input files.

rollback.strategy: Remove the bp_dispatch_planning unit and its render path and its bp_index route.

retired_reason: superseded by prod PA-fix versions; prevent hash-mismatch fallback to world-refresh process version while keeping version history
